title.zh: SEMI举办AI半导体制造工作坊，焦点从模型展示转向良率和过程控制
title.en: SEMI workshop puts AI in semiconductor manufacturing on yield and process control

summary.zh: SEMI在8月5日至6日举办AI Techniques in Semiconductor Manufacturing工作坊，议题覆盖良率管理、故障检测与分类、运行中控制、实验设计和统计过程控制。这个活动的行业信号是，制造业AI正在从“能不能生成预测”转向“能不能嵌入稳定的工艺闭环”。对工程团队而言，真正的门槛包括传感器校准、数据可观测性、异常处置、设备接口和质量责任，而不仅是模型精度。先进工厂的建设和改造也会更多地要求结构、机电、自动化和数据团队在概念阶段共同定义接口。
summary.en: SEMI's 5–6 August workshop on AI techniques in semiconductor manufacturing covers yield-management systems, fault detection and classification, run-to-run control, design of experiments, and statistical process control. The industry signal is that manufacturing AI is moving from whether a model can predict to whether it can close a stable process loop. The real engineering barriers include sensor calibration, observability, anomaly response, equipment interfaces, and quality accountability, not model accuracy alone. Advanced-factory construction and retrofit will increasingly require structural, MEP, automation, and data teams to define interfaces together at concept stage.

watch.zh: 关注制造AI是否形成可审计的过程控制和质量责任链，而不是停留在演示型试点。
watch.en: Watch whether manufacturing AI creates auditable process control and quality accountability rather than demonstration pilots.

title.zh: fib发布钢—混凝土结构技术报告，组合结构的统一力学基础继续完善
title.en: fib publishes a technical bulletin on the mechanics of steel–concrete construction

summary.zh: fib Commission 2发布Bulletin 120，系统讨论钢—混凝土结构的受力基础、分析和设计模型。组合梁、组合柱和组合楼板能够同时利用钢材受拉和混凝土受压，但实际性能取决于剪力连接、施工阶段、界面滑移、长期效应和连接细节。对行业而言，技术报告的价值不只是提供计算公式，更在于推动不同国家规范和软件之间使用更一致的力学语言。工程师需要把施工顺序、连接刚度和长期变形纳入模型，而不能只把组合截面当作两种材料的简单叠加。
summary.en: fib Commission 2 has published Bulletin 120 on the mechanics, analysis, and design of steel–concrete construction. Composite beams, columns, and slabs use steel in tension and concrete in compression, but performance depends on shear connection, construction stage, interface slip, long-term effects, and detailing. The value of the bulletin is not only additional equations; it is a more coherent mechanical language across codes and software. Engineers need to include erection sequence, connection stiffness, and long-term movement in the model rather than treating a composite section as a simple addition of two materials.

watch.zh: 关注组合结构标准和软件是否更好地表达施工阶段、部分剪力连接和长期效应。
watch.en: Watch whether standards and software better represent construction stage, partial shear connection, and long-term effects.

referenceLinks.label: fib: The bases of steel–concrete construction

title.zh: 悉尼大学2026组合结构课程把澳洲与国际规范放进同一套设计训练
title.en: The University of Sydney's 2026 composite-structures course links Australian and international design practice

summary.zh: 悉尼大学2026年CIVL6264课程把钢—混凝土组合梁、楼板、柱和楼盖系统作为完整设计对象，并要求学生结合澳洲标准、国际规范、施工性和使用性能比较方案。这个变化说明组合结构能力正在从单一构件计算转向系统设计：工程师要同时理解剪力连接、有效截面、施工阶段、挠度、耐火和成本。对个人职业发展而言，能够解释不同规范为什么采用不同的有效宽度和安全格式，比记住某个软件按钮更有迁移价值。
summary.en: The University of Sydney's 2026 CIVL6264 unit treats composite beams, slabs, columns, and floor systems as integrated design objects, requiring students to compare Australian and international guidance alongside constructability and serviceability. The signal is that composite capability is moving from one-member calculation to system design: engineers must understand shear connection, effective section properties, construction stage, deflection, fire, and cost together. For professional development, explaining why codes use different effective widths and safety formats is more transferable than memorising a software command.

watch.zh: 关注组合结构人才培养是否继续强化规范比较、施工阶段和跨专业协调能力。
watch.en: Watch whether composite-structures education continues to strengthen code comparison, construction-stage thinking, and interdisciplinary coordination.

title.zh: 组合结构的真正难点是界面传力和施工路径，而不是把两种材料放在一起
title.en: The real challenge in composite design is interface force transfer and construction path, not simply combining two materials

insights.evidence: University of Melbourne Steel and Composite Structures Research Group

summary.zh: 墨尔本大学钢与组合结构研究涵盖组合结构、模块化建筑、连接、可靠度和先进分析，反映出组合系统正在成为高效与低碳建造的重要路线。组合梁的理论优势只有在剪力连接、板件协同、施工支撑、界面滑移和长期变形得到控制时才能实现。对结构工程师，未来能力应包括分阶段建立刚度和荷载路径、识别完全与部分剪力连接的差异，并把构造可检查性写入设计文件。研究和软件模型可以帮助比较方案，但项目仍需按适用规范和实际施工顺序验证。
summary.en: The University of Melbourne's Steel and Composite Structures Research Group covers composite systems, modular buildings, connections, reliability, and advanced analysis, reflecting the role of composite construction in efficient and lower-carbon delivery. A composite beam only achieves its theoretical benefit when shear connection, slab interaction, temporary support, interface slip, and long-term movement are controlled. Future structural capability includes building stiffness and load paths by stage, distinguishing full from partial shear connection, and making inspectability part of the design record. Research and software can compare options, but projects still require code and actual erection-sequence verification.

caveat.zh: 组合模型对施工顺序、连接刚度和界面条件敏感；不能用最终截面性质覆盖所有施工阶段。
caveat.en: Composite models are sensitive to erection sequence, connection stiffness, and interface conditions; final-section properties cannot represent every construction stage.

insights.reference: University of Melbourne Steel and Composite Structures Research Group

title.zh: 有效宽度不是几何宽度的简单折扣，而是楼板应力分布和跨度共同决定的模型参数
title.en: Effective width is not a simple geometric discount; it represents slab stress distribution and span

insights.evidence: Institution of Structural Engineers and composite-beam research literature

summary.zh: 组合梁有效宽度的经典研究指出，宽楼板中的中性轴位置和应力分布会受到剪力滞后影响，有效宽度与板厚、梁间距、跨度和荷载形式相关。对工程师而言，不能把有效宽度只当作软件里的一个默认比例；在连续梁、边梁、框架体系和桥梁箱梁中，局部楼板参与程度可能显著不同。未来的可靠设计需要说明有效宽度的适用范围、规范来源和对弯矩、挠度及连接需求的影响。复杂体系应通过试验、有限元或规范允许的替代方法验证，而不是盲目放大参与宽度。
summary.en: Classic research on composite-beam effective width shows that shear lag changes the neutral-axis depth and stress distribution across a wide slab; effective width depends on slab thickness, beam spacing, span, and loading. Engineers should not treat effective width as a default software ratio. In continuous beams, edge beams, frame systems, and box-girder bridges, the participating slab width can differ substantially. Reliable design requires the source, applicability, and influence of effective width on moment, deflection, and connection demand to be stated. Complex systems should be checked with tests, finite elements, or a code-permitted alternative rather than by assuming a larger participating width.

caveat.zh: 不同规范对有效宽度的定义和适用条件并不完全一致；跨国项目必须避免直接移植一个国家的比例。
caveat.en: Codes do not define effective width and applicability identically; international projects should not transfer one country's ratio without review.

insights.reference: The Structural Engineer and Institution of Structural Engineers effective-width paper

area.zh: 组合结构与未来工程能力
area.en: Composite systems and future engineering capability

title.zh: 组合结构把结构分析、施工管理和全寿命性能放进同一个职业能力模型
title.en: Composite structures place analysis, construction management, and whole-life performance in one professional capability model

insights.evidence: University of Sydney CIVL6264 2026 learning outcomes

summary.zh: 悉尼大学的组合结构课程把强度、使用性、施工性和实际工程约束并列为学习成果，说明组合结构不再是材料专业之间的狭窄交叉点。钢—混凝土体系的优势需要在吊装、临时支撑、连接施工、楼板浇筑、长期收缩徐变和后期改造中持续保持。对职业发展而言，能够把规范条文转译成阶段荷载路径、检查点和数据记录，将比只会做最终截面的软件建模更有价值。边界在于，课程目标是能力训练，真实项目仍要由责任工程师按当地标准和现场条件作出判断。
summary.en: The University of Sydney's composite-structures learning outcomes place strength, serviceability, constructability, and practical engineering constraints together. Composite design is therefore not a narrow intersection between material disciplines. The benefit of a steel–concrete system must survive lifting, temporary support, connection installation, slab casting, long-term shrinkage and creep, and future alteration. For professional development, translating clauses into staged load paths, inspection points, and data records is more valuable than modelling only the final section in software. The boundary is that a course develops capability; a real project still requires the responsible engineer's judgement under local standards and site conditions.

caveat.zh: 组合结构的长期性能和施工质量可能控制最终收益；设计文件应明确阶段假设与现场验收。
caveat.en: Long-term performance and construction quality may govern the benefit of a composite system; design records should state stage assumptions and site acceptance.

title.zh: 组合梁不是两种材料简单相加：中外规范如何处理有效宽度、剪力连接和施工阶段？
title.en: A composite beam is not a simple addition of two materials: how codes treat effective width, shear connection, and construction stage

text.zh: 钢—混凝土组合梁利用钢梁受拉、混凝土板受压，但这种协同只有在界面剪力能够可靠传递时才成立。中国、澳洲和欧洲规范都要求考虑有效宽度、剪力连接和施工阶段，但符号、有效宽度表达和安全格式不完全相同。Eurocode 4通常把有效宽度、连接程度和施工阶段分层处理；澳洲设计教育也强调组合梁、楼板、柱和楼盖系统的强度、使用性与施工性；中国规范体系则将栓钉连接、组合截面和施工阶段验算纳入相应条文。真正的比较不应只比较一个有效宽度比例，而应说明跨度、支承条件、板厚、梁间距、连接形式和是否有临时支撑。
text.en: A steel–concrete composite beam uses the steel beam primarily in tension and the concrete slab in compression, but the action only develops when interface shear is transferred reliably. Chinese, Australian, and European standards all address effective width, shear connection, and construction stage, but their symbols, effective-width expressions, and safety formats differ. Eurocode 4 commonly treats effective width, degree of connection, and construction stage in separate layers. Australian design education likewise links beam, slab, column, and floor-system strength, serviceability, and constructability. Chinese provisions include stud connection, composite-section, and construction-stage checks in their relevant clauses. A useful comparison therefore states span, support, slab thickness, beam spacing, connection, and temporary support rather than comparing one ratio alone.

label.zh: 有效宽度是应力分布模型

text.zh: 它不是楼板真实几何宽度的永久削减，而是把非均匀纵向应力折算为可用于截面分析的等效宽度。
text.en: It is not a permanent geometric reduction of the slab; it converts non-uniform longitudinal stress into an equivalent width for section analysis.

label.zh: 剪力连接决定协同程度
label.en: Shear connection determines the degree of composite action

text.zh: 完全连接、部分连接和滑移会改变中性轴、内力分配、挠度和连接需求；不能只按钢梁和混凝土板的材料强度叠加。
text.en: Full connection, partial connection, and slip change the neutral axis, force distribution, deflection, and connector demand; material strengths cannot simply be added.

label.zh: 施工阶段可能控制结构

text.zh: 混凝土未硬化前，钢梁可能独立承担湿混凝土、施工荷载和设备荷载；最终组合截面不能覆盖这一阶段。
text.en: Before the concrete hardens, the steel beam may carry wet concrete, construction loads, and equipment loads alone; the final composite section cannot cover this stage.

takeaway.zh: 组合设计的第一步不是把材料强度相加，而是确认界面传力、有效宽度和施工阶段；只有荷载路径闭合，组合截面优势才具有工程意义。
takeaway.en: The first step in composite design is not adding material strengths; it is confirming interface transfer, effective width, and construction stage. The composite-section benefit only has engineering meaning when the load path is closed.

title.zh: 参考实例：组合梁有效宽度与塑性弯矩的概念筛查
title.en: Worked reference: conceptual screening of effective width and plastic moment

intro.zh: 以下关系用于说明组合梁的概念分析，属于派生关系和简化筛查，不是对某一规范条文的逐字转录。正式设计应根据GB、AS或EN适用条文确定有效宽度、栓钉数量、连接程度、材料设计强度和施工阶段荷载。
intro.en: The relations below explain a conceptual composite-beam analysis. They are derived relations and simplified screens, not verbatim reproductions of one code clause. Formal design must determine effective width, stud number, degree of connection, material design strengths, and construction-stage actions under the applicable GB, AS, or EN provisions.

label.zh: 有效宽度简化表达（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：用于说明有效宽度受几何和跨度约束的概念筛查；正式设计应引用EN 1994-1-1、AS 2327或GB适用条文，不能将该简化式当作所有体系的规范公式。
citation.en: Derived relation: a conceptual screen showing that effective width is bounded by geometry and span. Formal design must use the applicable EN 1994-1-1, AS 2327, or GB provisions; this simplified relation is not universal code equation.

label.zh: 混凝土压区合力（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：以等效压应力块说明混凝土压区合力；实际应按适用规范的应力块、有效高度和连接程度确定。
citation.en: Derived relation: represents the concrete compression resultant using an equivalent stress block. The applicable code stress block, effective depth, and degree of connection govern formal design.

citation.zh: Derived relation：以内力偶N꜀与力臂z说明组合弯矩抗力；不是规范专属公式，正式设计需核对钢材、混凝土、连接、稳定和施工阶段。
citation.en: Derived relation: illustrates composite moment resistance as the internal couple N꜀ acting through lever arm z. It is not code-specific; steel, concrete, connection, stability, and construction-stage checks remain required.

note.zh: 例如，若有效宽度由跨度和楼板几何共同限制，且混凝土压区合力为900 kN、内力臂为0.45 m，则概念弯矩抗力约为Mᵣd≈405 kN·m。该数值不能替代栓钉抗剪、钢梁稳定、施工阶段和长期效应验算。
note.en: For example, if geometry and span limit the effective width and the concrete compression resultant is 900 kN with a 0.45 m lever arm, the conceptual moment resistance is Mᵣd≈405 kN·m. This does not replace checks of stud shear, steel stability, construction stage, or long-term effects.
